subject: Claude Inbox Core #1: World-Class Declarative Config (Zero Hardcoded Rules/Timeouts) & Protocol Engineering for Founder Wellbeing + Zero-MacBook Friction NFRs
payloadSummary: Eliminates hardcoded rules, protocols, and rigid timeouts in code by externalizing all behavioral governance into register/protocol-config.json. Replaces binary hard-timeout failures with Progressive Partial-Value Yield ('better to deliver some value than none'). Enforces Non-Functional Requirements (Founder Wellbeing: 0 MacBook tether minutes; Friction: 0 manual interventions) upstream via Protocol Engineering so late CI/CD gates are rarely hit.

bddContract.given: Declarative manifest register/protocol-config.json is loaded by bin/estate-protocol-engine with zero hardcoded timeouts in code
bddContract.when: node bin/estate-protocol-engine --json executes upstream protocol engineering and NFR verification
